exposure: American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) class of ≥ 3
CDs performed for nonreassuring fetal status
cohort: 2,739 women who underwent cesarean delivery at the University of Pittsburgh in 2011
finding: Labor, chorioamnionitis, resident teaching service, tobacco use, ASA class ≥ 3, and CDs performed for nonreassuring fetal status were significantly associated with CD SSI.
mod_finding: Labor before cesarean delivery was significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery surgical site infection.
